notes: All currently indexed AirPods Pro 2 variants discovered in AutoEq. Crinacle raw measurement files are referenced by AutoEq name_index but are not redistributed in the AutoEq repository; this manifest preserves every indexed variant and source path so we do not collapse the volume-dependent/adaptive measurements into one profile.
